reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the plan still needed revising in the last round (round 3 of 3). The plan's core design holds up against the code: strip trailers once in Committer::build_commit_in (commits.rs:150) and commit_with_staged (manage.rs:407), keyed on the parent's cutover state; keep the trailer readers and add a C0..head fallback; add a strict/relaxed squash_text split (athena-git lib.rs:715). Moving the change into gate lib.rs and manage.rs is justified, and both stay inside the named crates. The weak point is the main demonstration. land_pr is a job-landing entry point: LandPr requires a job, its landed commit and a verified fingerprint, and it refuses when the PR head differs from the job commit (gh.rs:1260, 1775-1805). So the planned 'three PRs, each through land_pr' cannot land a standalone intervention or records-only PR. The plan also leaves the fake host's merge method open, and under a squash the PR's own commits never reach HEAD to be judged. The plan's description of the history check is also inaccurate: after C0 it skips content, invariant and jobs checks, not just invariant. The planner should restructure the scratch test as one job PR whose range holds all three commit kinds, state the merge method, and correct the rationale. Verdict: revise. Findings: minor: crates/athena-gate/src/lib.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-gate/src/lib.rs); minor: crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs is not among the reading's deliverables (files, crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs); major: land_pr only lands a job's pull request, so the plan's 'three pull requests, each landed through land_pr' cannot include a standalone intervention PR or records-only PR. (Decision 5 / Demonstrations for criteria 1-2 (gh.rs scratch test)); major: The plan does not say how the fake host merges. Under a squash merge the PR's own commits never reach the base branch, so 'records attribute all three commits on HEAD' may not hold the way the test asserts. (Demonstrations for criteria 1-2: merge method and which commits reach the base); minor: The rationale misdescribes the history check. After C0 it skips content, invariant and jobs checks for every commit, not only invariant::check. (Decision 3 rationale ('history.rs:161 runs invariant::check only for commits up to C0, as check_history already does')); minor: This is a conditional deliverable, which decision 6 itself rejects as hard to check.
